name: DirectoryCreate
description: Creates new directory for specified path
syntax: DirectoryCreate( string path, [boolean createPath], [boolean ignoreExists], [string mode] )

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path of the directory to be created

params.name: createPath
params.description: Create parent directory when not exist

params.name: ignoreExists
params.description: Pass false (default) to throw an error if the directory already exists, or true to skip the create operation without an error

params.name: mode
params.description: Mode to for the new directory, pass -1 to inherit
